Issue description: AEM cuts product folder names after 50 characters, so the product's URL is not its folder name, and different products end up at the same URL. 92 TIBCO products (250 published versions) have folder names longer than 50 characters: 64 BW plug-ins, 10 BusinessConnect, 4 Adapters, 3 MFT, 3 Messaging, 2 Hawk, 2 BusinessWorks, and Platform, Streaming, ActiveSpaces and Fulfillment products. Example: tibco-businessconnect-configstore-management-interface-protocol is served at https://stg-docs.tibco.com/us/en/tibco-businessconnect-configstore-management-inter/online-help/6-1-0/index.html. Collisions: 24 products in 8 groups share one shortened folder, e.g. Apache Cassandra, Apache Kafka and Apache Pulsar all become tibco-activematrix-businessworks-plug-in-for-apach; six 'plug-in for TIBCO ...' products become ...-plug-in-for-tibco; BusinessConnect CE EDI and EDI HIPAA share one. In 7 cases two products also share a version number (Kafka and Pulsar 5.0.0; Amazon S3 and SQS/SNS 6.6.0; Oracle E-Business Suite and Tuxedo 6.1.2; AuditSafe, MFT, Patterns and eFTL plug-ins 1.0.0 to 6.3.1), so one overwrites the other. Redirects, cross-product links and the help IDs (csh.yml) use the full folder name, so they will not reach these pages. Ask: keep the full folder name in the URL (raise or remove the 50-character limit).
Comments: DOCOPS-346 (most of its 'not served' versions are this). Explains 58 of the 61 BW plug-ins in the earlier row and 21 other versions.
